name: Jovoy Paris
sentiment_summary: Widely seen as the temple of independent perfumery; staff are passionate and let visitors explore hundreds of houses at leisure.

name: Nose
sentiment_summary: Known for its olfactory diagnosis that recommends scents by profile; calm, pedagogic atmosphere with strong indie curation.

name: Sens Unique
sentiment_summary: Intimate Marais boutique praised for owners who champion small artisan houses and take time with every customer.

name: Marie Antoinette
sentiment_summary: Tiny jewel-box shop on a Marais square; reviewers love the founder's personal storytelling and rare discoveries.

name: Dover Street Parfums Market

name: Liquides Bar à Parfums

name: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella

name: Le Bon Marché Rive Gauche

name: Printemps Haussmann

name: Galeries Lafayette Haussmann

name: Galeries Lafayette Champs-Élysées

name: La Samaritaine (DFS)

name: BHV Marais

name: Serge Lutens – Palais Royal

name: Frédéric Malle

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian

name: Guerlain – 68 Champs-Élysées

name: Diptyque – Saint-Germain

name: Ex Nihilo
